note: Files under docs/app/lib REPLACED under their own names. /lib/ is served cache-first and never revalidated, so a replacement is invisible to a returning device until a LIB_PURGES entry NEWER than it clears the cached copy. Recording the shipped bytes here means the next replacement changes the hash and fails the check until whoever made it adds a purge entry and updates this record. Icons are absent by design: LIB_ICON_RE routes them through the network-first branch. 6.7.1: the 6.6.1 entries ran but refilled from the browser's HTTP cache, so their markers are spent on every device and the repair never landed — these files are re-pinned to the new __lib-purge-v6-7-1-http-refill entry, whose refill bypasses that cache. 6.10.0: the ten vt cards re-arted as one set — re-pinned to __lib-purge-v6-10-0-cards-v3 (vt-headswap joins the record: first replaced here). 6.17.0: couple-compose.jpg redrawn for the three-input redesign — pinned to __lib-purge-v6-17-0-couple-compose. 6.29.2: Imagine's banner, four card pairs and 54 template thumbnails re-shot on the brand model under their own names (6.29.1 had replaced the thumbnails and the banner in place with no entry) — pinned to __lib-purge-v6-29-2-imagine. 6.29.3: the Imagine hero's motion clip pair (mp4 + webm), replaced in place in 6.29.2 — recorded under the same tag;
